title: Mirabel and the Echo
author: Freya Sterling
blurb: Bram Voss, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
